0.0.3.en: Fixed some broken requires and dependencies

0.0.4.en: Fixed scheduling bug, added support and community links

0.0.5.en: Added support for SIM, VKR and unlisted Min Renovasjon municipalities.

0.0.6.en: Fixed bug where 'fetch' is not defined on Homey 2019

0.0.7.en: Added more providers, added adapter testing

0.0.8.en: Fixed bug in IR and MinRenovasjon when looking up municipality.

0.0.10.en: Added support for Sandnes, Stavanger, Time; fixed next pickup flowcard; removed unnecessary adapters; improved testing.

1.1.0.en: Fixed graphics, added support for SUM, improved testing.

1.2.0.en: Added widget; added support for providers SOR, LAS, Karmøy; fixed Avfall Sør and IRIS; stability improvements.

1.3.0.en: Added action card to tokenize collected fractions; added hidden capabilities for formatted date and number of days until next pickup; reduced logging.

1.3.1.en: Fixed bug that caused app to crash if data fetch came up empty

1.3.2.en: Small refactor to decrease memory footprint; added testing to ensure fetched fraction dates are in the future; fixed SUM adapter that showed dates in the past; fixed Avfall Sør adapter after API changed.

1.3.3.en: Fixed adapter for Oslo kommune, improved testing.

1.3.4.en: Fixed Oslo kommune adapter; Ignore past dates in next pickup date calculation.

1.3.5.en: Fixed Min Renovasjon missing fractions in some municipalities; improved device recovery from provider changes and startup errors; removed GLØR and VKR adapters (covered by Min Renovasjon).
